notes.title: Long Dream Demo is now available！
notes.content:
Ready for a time travel？

In this demo, you will return to the unforgettable years with Wang Han and his Grandpa Han Zhaosheng.

Enjoy the game and don't forget to wishlist it!

notes.title: Play Long Dream Demo on September 29th
notes.content:
Hello bad kids, 

Long Dream Demo will be released on September 29th！

You will follow the step of Wang Han and his grandpa Han Zhaosheng to recall Zhaosheng's past as postman and look for Qimei in his memory.

The demo is about 40 minutes in length.

Don't forget to wishlist the game to get latest news!

notes.title: Long Dream Announced Today!
notes.content:
Long Dream is my second game. The story will focus on Wang Han's grandpa Han Zhaosheng. He will cross time and space in his remaining life searching for the place where he and his partner made a promise to each other. Meanwhile, Wang Han is grown up and will witness the story of the older generation with us.

Long Dream is expected to launch in February 2023. 

Wishlist my game if you are interested in pixel narrative game. 

Thanks for your attention and support!
